svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Cup Day's surest bet
svg.desc: Original pen-and-ink editorial cartoon. In a suburban Australian lounge room decorated with Melbourne Cup bunting, a fictional man in a striped polo shirt and shorts rubs the back of his neck and holds a losing betting ticket, saying "My horse came in last…". Beside him a fictional woman in a floral dress and fascinator holds up a letter from her bank headed "New repayment: up again" and replies "The bank's horse won again." The TV shows a horse race with a news ticker: "Cup Day 2:30pm: cash rate up 0.25 to 4.85%". Through the window are a gum tree, a paling fence and a weatherboard house.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY

g.text: CUP DAY • 2:30PM: CASH RATE UP 0.25 TO 4.85%

svg.text: THE ONLY SURE THING ON CUP DAY WAS THE RATE RISE.
Source: ABC News, 3 November 2026 — the RBA lifted the cash rate to 4.85%, its fifth rise this year, on Melbourne Cup day.
